rights.basis: The Library of Congress finding aid states that copyright in the Wright brothers’ unpublished writings in its custody has been dedicated to the public. The January 1904 public statement is also a historical published text. Only the three Wright-authored primary texts are admitted; modern editorial essays are excluded.

Remove running page headings and document headings; join consecutive pages.

source_family: All three accounts come from the same participants. NASA, LOC, NPS and Smithsonian are custodians/reproducers or verification authorities, not additional independent eyewitnesses.
access_note: Direct LOC item/collection pages returned 403 during this session; their indexed official catalog/finding-aid entries and the accessible NASA/NPS documents verified identity. Do not claim a new inspection of LOC handwriting.
